writeup: Woot has the new Sylvania Proscan CD clock radio with USB charger, models SCR4986 and PCR4896, for $12.99. It can wake you with a CD, the radio, or a buzzer, and the USB port can charge a phone. Mazeeg has the exact Proscan PCR4896 in stock at $25.09, and Toner Ink Supply lists the Sylvania SCR4986 (UPC 058465783129) at $31.10, so this is $12.10 and 48 percent below the lowest verified street price. Only two are left on this drop.
